title: Ledger row (a Tag decisions row as a pull writes it)
description: One line of norm/queue.jsonl: a row of Tag decisions, the agent's ledger, as plain values keyed by the Notion column names. One row per claim and tag the agent judged, written and superseded by the agent only. Tag outcome, Why wrong, Your reasoning and Decided under are copies the agent makes from the claim once an editor has Reviewed it. decided is true when Tag outcome is set.

Key.description: The claim's Geo ID, two colons, the tag.

Rulebook edition.description: The edition the proposal was made under.

Tag outcome.description: Copied from the claim: Applies when the tag is in its verified tags, else Does not apply.

Why wrong.description: Copied from the claim, for a tag whose outcome differs from the proposal.

Your reasoning.description: Copied from the claim's Challenged tags notes: the tag's own line, else the whole text.

Decided under.description: The edition the proposal the editor saw was made under.
